content.name: Callum Briggs
content.title: Customer Service Advisor
content.summary: Friendly customer service advisor with two years of retail and contact centre experience, now handling billing and meter queries for an energy supplier. Consistently scores above 90% on call quality and was the fastest in my intake to sign off on complaint handling.

experience.title: Sales Assistant (part-time)
bullets: Served customers on the tills and shop floor at weekends and through the summer, often 200 transactions a shift in peak season.
Handled refunds and exchanges in line with store policy, calmly sorting out complaints about plants and delivered goods.
Helped set up the Christmas grotto booking system and took phone bookings for over 600 family slots.

experience.title: Customer Service Advisor
bullets: Take around 55 calls a day on bills, smart meter readings, payment plans and moving home for domestic customers.
Set up affordable payment plans for customers in arrears and flag vulnerable customers to the Priority Services Register.
Hold a call quality score averaging 92% against a team target of 85%.
Signed off to handle formal complaints after four months, two months ahead of the usual timeline, following Ofgem complaint-handling rules.

education.degree: GCSEs: 8 at grades 9–5, including English Language (6) and Maths (6)

courses.name: Mental Health Awareness for Customer-Facing Staff

achievements.title: Duke of Edinburgh Silver Award
achievements.detail: Completed volunteering, skills and expedition sections over 12 months.

achievements.title: Star of the month
achievements.detail: Picked by the team leader at Pennine Energy Direct in March 2025 for customer feedback.
